Maya (AE): FYI MedVerge wants to POC neo-13b-ft this week. Hosted demo Wed -> Dedicated later. Requirements: p95 <200ms for chat, int4 option, prefix/KV cache, KMS (AWS CMK), and hosted pricing for ~80M gen tokens/mo. Can infra validate compatibility and perf? cc @Sam

Sam (Infra): Starting compat sweep. Need artifact format and any adapters.

Maya (AE): HF tar.gz with a small LoRA. Config flags show rmsnorm and kv_cache:true. Upload link in dealbook.

deploy-bot: compat-scan queued for 6239990000

deploy-bot: compat-scan results:
- tokenizer: OK
- kv_cache: SUPPORTED
- rmsnorm: FALLBACK on prod runtime (no fused kernel)
- int4: PASS (requires quant-profile B2 and small attention-scale fix)
- LoRA: adapters detected; merging advised for latency-sensitive POC

Sam (Infra): I'll patch canary runtime with rmsnorm fusion and run microbench on qsm-rt-4. Will also test int4 B2.

Pri (Sales Eng): I'll draft hosted vs dedicated estimates but need p95 numbers. Tentative hosted ballpark for 80M tokens ~ $900-$2.5k/mo depending on cache hit-rate.

Sam (Infra): Microbench (qsm-rt-4, int4 B2, merged LoRA, batch=6): steady-state p95 ~170ms for 1k context; cold-start ~380ms. With prefix cache warmup p95 ~150ms. Canary with rmsnorm fusion rolled.

Noor (Security): Reminder: PHI may be used. Need AWS CMK wiring, signed DPA before ingest, and audit log retention. Please add KMS wiring docs to dealbook.

Sam (Infra): Added KMS checklist and step-by-step. deploy-bot provisioned hosted trial (trial-id: mv-623999). Endpoint creds uploaded to dealbook.

deploy-bot: hosted-trial provisioned (mv-623999)

Maya (AE): Got creds, sharing with customer. Demo scheduled Wed 11am PT. Thanks team — ping here if anything regresses before demo. :party:
